title: Shattered Sanity
synopsis:
In a world where Ascendants cultivated Aether to evolve beyond ordinary mortals, those born without special bloodlines, inherited talents, or powerful family legacies rarely amounted to anything significant.

However, that was precisely why historians studied the life of Riven Veyr, with such obsession, because despite being born within a desolate northern tribe that barely understood Ascension itself, Riven eventually became the man who broke the world.

Some believed his greatest advantage was the simple fact that he was insane.

Others claimed it was his monstrous willingness to grow stronger regardless of cost, consequence, or morality that separated him from everyone else.

Whatever the truth may have been, one thing remained undeniable.

Riven Veyr’s existence changed civilization forever.

To the downtrodden, he became a symbol of hope.

A living proof that even someone born with nothing could one day rise high enough to shake the status quo.

While to the elite, he became a dangerous name that needed to be erased from history before his story inspired others to walk the same bloody path.

However, while some came to worship him as a hero and others cursed his name as a monster, to the common man, he simply became the terrifying legend known as The Laughing Calamity.
